text:
maya: Heads-up — planning to enable siren-v2 in the model catalog during the 17:30 UTC change window. This is a preemptive pin (non-blocking) with safemode fallback ordering. Can ops + SRE confirm the rollout sequence and rollback criteria?

liam: ack. want a region-staggered activation. start with us-west, then us-east, then eu.

evan: observed EU queue pressure during the last cold-start. if we hit queue saturation in eu for >3m we should pause the EU activation and fallback globally.

maya: noted. proposed fallback order (priority high->low):
```
- siren-v2: primary (quant-optim)
- siren-v1: legacy exact
- small-fallback: low-cost safe model
```
Please validate.

irene: adding release-notes stub now: "siren-v2: 7B quantized, ~18% cost savings, matched evals on core prompts" — will link once published.

liam: rollback signal proposal:
- latency p95 > 350ms sustained for 5m or
- error rate spike >= 3x baseline for 3m or
- top-5 customers see >1% rejection rate in a 10m window
If any trigger trips, we pin back to siren-v1 and open rollback incident.

product-ops: adding canary traffic cap: 20% of baseline per region during first 30m. Also enable canary telemetry tags (catalog.enable=canary).

maya: @deploybot please schedule a dry-run for 17:20 UTC and then the actual enable at 17:30 UTC with the following config:
```yaml
change_window: 17:30-17:45 UTC
regions_sequence: [us-west, us-east, eu]
canary_percent: 20
fallback_order: [siren-v2, siren-v1, small-fallback]
rollback_criteria: [p95>350ms_5m, err_rate>3x_3m, customer_reject>1%_10m]
```

deploybot: deploybot: dry-run scheduled for 1717123200 (17:20 UTC). Actual enable scheduled for 1717123456 (17:30 UTC). Canary throttles and fallback order applied.

sre_oncall: I'll standby for the window and watch alerts: catalog-latency-p95, catalog-error-rate, catalog-queue-fill. Pager rule copied to the thread.

evan: one more — please set the cache warmup grace to 120s for this model (avoids initial K/V churn).

maya: setting cache_warmup=120s. final checklist: release notes link, deploybot scheduled dry-run + enable, SRE monitoring, product canary cap. If no objections by 17:05 UTC we proceed. :thumbsup:

liam: +1

irene: +1, publishing notes in ~5m and tagging catalog entry.

product-ops: +1 from rollout planning, will update the changelog entry post-cutover.

maya: thanks everyone. will post a short postmortem template in #postmortems if any rollback happens.

deploybot: deploybot: dry-run completed at 1717123205 — no immediate failures. Ready for enable at 1717123456. Link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/d/1717123456/siren-v2-enable

sre_oncall: monitoring now. I will call rollback if thresholds hit and document timeline here.

maya: enable in 10. sitting on the window.

(threads like this are intentionally terse; we'll expand in the post-rollout notes if anything unusual shows up.)
